Where We Play & Train

A real pathway, close to home.

Fun and learning come first — for every age group — while our competitive squads build toward Ontario provincial and Canadian national cricket.

Home Ground

Central Park, Burlington

Our home ground for matches and academy events.

Training

Hitzone, Burlington

Wednesdays & Fridays, 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM.

Competitive Leagues

TDCA · HDCL · SOCA · MCPL

TDCA HDCL SOCA MCPL
Age Groups

Leather-ball cricket, from U11 to U19.

Every group trains and competes at the level that's right for them, with a clear pathway upward.

U11

Foundations

First steps in leather-ball cricket — grip, stance, and throwing mechanics through games-based coaching.

U13

Development

Batting technique, pace and spin bowling basics, and fielding drills in competitive league play.

U15

Pathway Squad

For players building toward provincial trials, club-level cricket, and beyond.

U17

Advanced Squad

High-performance training and competitive league play for players approaching senior cricket.

U19

Senior Pathway

The final step before club, provincial, and national-level cricket.

Enrollment

Simple, not-for-profit pricing.

Halton Cricket Academy is a not-for-profit organization. Enrollment is open to kids ages 6 and up.

1 Class / Week
$120 / month

One weekly training session at Hitzone, Burlington.
